content_sections.heading: About Maharishi Valmiki Hospital
content_sections.text: Maharishi Valmiki Hospital is a hospital of the Government of N.C.T. of Delhi at Pooth Khurd, Delhi-110039. The Office of the Medical Superintendent issued this recruitment notice. Dr. Jitendra Kumar, Medical Superintendent, signed it.

content_sections.heading: MVH Junior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice says that the number of vacancies may vary. Reservation for physically handicapped candidates will be allowed as per rule. If no suitable reserved-category candidates are available, the reserved seats will be filled by general-category or other-category candidates on an ad hoc basis. content_sections.heading: MVH Junior Resident Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted on the date of the interview. MBBS from a recognized university. Must have completed the one-year internship not before 2 years as on the date of interview. Must be enrolled with the Delhi Medical Council. Must not have completed 01 year of Junior Residency in any Govt. hospital in India. OBC (Non Creamy Layer, belonging to Delhi only) and EWS candidates need a valid certificate issued by the Competent Authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi. If no candidates are available under the Residency Scheme, candidates may be considered under the relaxation in circular no. F.121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10/06/2011 of the Department of H&FW, GNCT of Delhi: The upper age limit will be 40 years in place of 30 years. Postgraduate doctors who want to serve as Junior Residents may join if fresh graduates are not available. Junior Residents who have already completed one year of Junior Residency may appear again. They will be offered residency only if no fresh Junior Residents are available. No Junior Resident appointed under the relaxed provisions will get an extension beyond one year. The list of fresh candidates will be used first. The second list will be used only after that. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by an interview panel at the hospital. Fresh candidates are listed first. Candidates under the relaxed provisions are placed on a second list, which is used only after the fresh list has been exhausted.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely ad hoc, for 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Ad hoc Junior Residents are likely to have their services ended when Medical Officers and regular Junior Residents join through the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, even if the 89 days are not complete. Hostel accommodation is compulsory for Junior Residents. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MVH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notice and print the application form attached to it. No form will be provided at the walk-in. Tick the relevant box: Fresh Candidate or Relaxed Category Candidate. Paste your photograph and fill in the form in capital letters only. Fill in your details: post and speciality, Aadhaar number, date of birth, addresses, mobile number, email ID, category, education with your number of attempts in MBBS, internship completion date, and your Delhi Medical Council registration number and date. Arrange self-attested copies of your documents in the order of the checklist and tick each item. Sign the declaration. Report at Maharishi Valmiki Hospital, Pooth Khurd, Delhi-110039 on 17 November 2026 at 10:00 AM with your original documents. No candidate will be let in after 11.30 AM. Application form Matriculation (10th) certificate for date of birth Senior Secondary School marks sheet/certificate MBBS marks sheets for all years MBBS degree Internship completion certificate, or FMG exam passed Attempt certificate Valid DMC certificate Certificate (PwD/Caste/EWS etc.) to claim reservation Aadhaar card Any other relevant certificate Experience certificate, if any

faq.question: Q1. When and at what time is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 17 November 2026 and reporting starts at 10:00 AM. The interview begins after 11.00 AM, and no candidate will be let in after 11.30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Which category are the vacancies for?
faq.answer: Both vacancies are for OBC candidates. The OBC certificate must be Non Creamy Layer, for candidates belonging to Delhi only, and issued by the Competent Authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How long does the appointment last?
faq.answer: It lasts 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. It can end before 89 days when Medical Officers and regular Junior Residents join.

faq.question: Q4. What if I completed my internship more than two years ago?
faq.answer: You must have completed the one-year internship not before 2 years as on the date of interview, so you do not meet the main condition. The relaxed provisions allow postgraduate doctors and past Junior Residents to be considered only if no fresh candidates are available.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply if I am over 30?
faq.answer: The limit is 30 years for General, 33 for OBC and 35 for SC/ST candidates. Under the relaxed provisions, the upper age limit can go up to 40 years if no candidates are available under the scheme.

faq.question: Q6. Will the application form be given at the venue?
faq.answer: No. The form is attached to the notice, on pages 3 and 4. You must bring it already filled in.

faq.question: Q7. Is hostel accommodation optional?
faq.answer: No. The notice says hostel accommodation is compulsory for Junior Residents.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get travel allowance for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is Delhi Medical Council registration required?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be enrolled with the Delhi Medical Council and must bring a valid DMC certificate. The form also asks for the registration number and date.
